memories.author: D05
memories.text: Iron-deficiency anemia. Patient reports fatigue and mild dyspnea on exertion. Examination shows pallor, no lymphadenopathy, lungs clear. Hb low, MCV low, ferritin low. Plan: check CBC, ferritin, start iron supplementation.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 9.2 g/dL (12-16), Serum ferritin 12 ng/mL (15-150), MCV 78 fL (80-100).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD for 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Iron-deficiency anemia. Patient feels less tired, reports mild constipation. Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (92% pred), FVC 3.40 L (95%), FEV1/FVC 0.84, unchanged from baseline. Asthma Control Test 22 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking status: never. Plan: repeat labs, continue iron.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 10.8 g/dL (12-16), Serum ferritin 28 ng/mL (15-150), MCV 82 fL (80-100).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days for 2 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Refer to Gastroenterology for evaluation of possible gastrointestinal blood loss contributing to iron deficiency. Please perform upper and lower endoscopy as clinically indicated.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Iron-deficiency anemia. Patient reports improved energy, no GI symptoms. Spirometry: FEV1 2.90 L (94% pred), FVC 3.45 L (96%), FEV1/FVC 0.84, +0.05 L since last test. Asthma Control Test 23 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking: never. Plan: await gastroenterology outcome, continue iron alternate days.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 11.6 g/dL (12-16), Serum ferritin 35 ng/mL (15-150), MCV 84 fL (80-100).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days continue.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: Feeling unusually tired again over past week, also noticing mild shortness of breath when climbing stairs. Request advice.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2026-02-10 at 10:00 AM with Dr Suresh Menon.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Iron-deficiency anemia. Patient reports fatigue returning, mild exertional dyspnea. Spirometry: FEV1 2.78 L (90% pred), FVC 3.38 L (94%), FEV1/FVC 0.82, -0.07 L since last test. Asthma Control Test 18 (not well controlled). Technique corrected: reminded to exhale slowly after inhalation. Smoking: never. Plan: repeat labs, consider restarting daily iron.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 10.4 g/dL (12-16), Serum ferritin 22 ng/mL (15-150), MCV 80 fL (80-100).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD for 8 weeks, then reassess.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Iron-deficiency anemia. Patient reports resolution of fatigue, good exercise tolerance. Spirometry: FEV1 2.92 L (95% pred), FVC 3.48 L (97%), FEV1/FVC 0.84, +0.14 L since 02-10 test. Asthma Control Test 22 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking: never. Plan: check labs, consider tapering iron.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 12.8 g/dL (12-16), Serum ferritin 48 ng/mL (15-150), MCV 86 fL (80-100).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Ferrous sulfate discontinued. Advise dietary iron-rich foods and multivitamin as needed.
